decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot remains a core, low-cost option with unresolved market value, so keeping it open is still warranted.
As an automatic de-shuttering option with no negative signals and modest holding costs, it is too early to abandon.
Although less central, the profile storage robot still has unresolved niche potential and low abandonment cost, so the option remains open.
The automatic shuttering robot is closely related to proven offers and shows no clear evidence that its value will not be realized.
Launched only in 2024 as a product line, its prospects remain highly uncertain and keeping the option open is still inexpensive.
The production analysis software is close to the established offer and cheap to maintain, making early abandonment unjustified.
